notes.title: Summer Sale and Awards
notes.content:
Luna is 30% off during the Summer Sale! Now's the perfect time to get Luna, in case you haven't picked it up yet.  ;)

We're honored that Luna has won four awards over the past few months:
    Taipei Game Show 2018 Indie Game Awards - Best VR Game
    VRCORE 2017 - VRCORE Award 2018 Windows Developer Awards
    Windows Developer Awards - Game Creator of the Year
    Brazil's Indie Game Festival - Best VR Game

Here's the Best VR Game award at Taipei Game Show in January:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30527474/99f0baaf4fe2cc1501f9ea992e5338fdfd626db6.jpg[/img]

Here's Eddy with the Best VR Game award at BIG Festival:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30527474/1f3d9e41248a38e7d9180a0e25a202e2832fbd21.jpg[/img]

Thanks to everyone who has already played Luna, and please share this VR experience with your friends and family as well.

Edit: Added BIG Festival award. Hooray!

notes.title: UPDATE 1.1 - LUNA PC IS NOW AVAILABLE (NO VR REQUIRED)!
notes.content:
Today we are thrilled to announce the release of Luna for all of those without a VR headset! 

The 2D version runs the same as the VR version, but it's adapted to be fully playable with mouse and keyboard.

In addition to adding PC/2D support, all versions of the game (VR and PC) also feature:
- Hidden secrets and surprises to be uncovered in each level
- New, more engaging puzzle mechanics 
- General art and performance improvements

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Luna
notes.content:
Luna is Now Available on Steam!

Luna is an interactive PC and VR fairytale. Solve puzzles in stardust and grow magical gardens in musical terrariums. Re-awaken shadowy forests and sparkling lakes, discover hidden creatures. Reunite the fragmented Moon so Bird can find its way home.
